data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a small net prior-year release of approximately GBP 5.7m (about 2.4% of opening gross claims outstanding). This release was driven by favourable claims development and settlements (notably reductions in 2012 and earlier liability reserves) and unusually light utilisation of IBNR. However, movements were mixed by line: while several property and reinsurance areas saw releases, third party liability showed an adverse movement, so the overall picture is mixed despite a net release.
raw_causal_phrases: a reduction in the 2012 and prior year's liability reserves as a result of favourable settlements in 2015.
The utilisation of the reserve for incurred but not reported claims has been exceptionally light.
the continuing and increasingly favourable trends experienced during the last few years in incurred claims development on all years of account.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross values) by comparing the current ultimate to the previous diagonal for underwriting years <= 2013. Per-line movement table available in the report is presented as NET of reinsurance; those net per-line figures were used for LOB-level movements with lower confidence. No explicit single gross 'movement in prior years' aggregate was provided, so the triangle calculation is the primary gross source. Mapping of statutory class names to standard Lloyd's LOBs is approximate for the reinsurance classes.
